articles.title: Why PayPal (PYPL) Stock Is Nosediving
articles.summary: StockStory: Why PayPal (PYPL) Stock Is Nosediving. Shares of digital payments platform PayPal (NASDAQ:PYPL) fell 19.8% in the afternoon session after the company reported fourth-quarter 2025 results that missed Wall Street's expectations for both revenue and earnings. The digital payments company posted revenue of $8.68 billion, a 3.7% increase year on year, but this fell short of analyst estimates of $8.78 billion.
